tasks.title: Evaluate content globs relative to source roots
tasks.problem: Slash-containing rg globs see absolute mount paths and give wrong matches.
tasks.proposal: Run one rg from each mounted tree root; preserve rg pruning and relative output.
acceptance: Include/exclude bdir/** works for content and -l in a real FUSE fixture.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.

tasks.title: Exit quietly when an output consumer closes its pipe
tasks.problem: Piping output to head can report bogus traversal errors and leak a traceback.
tasks.proposal: Keep emission outside traversal exception handling and return 141 after normal resource cleanup.
acceptance: Closed content pipe produces no diagnostics and leaves no mounts.
A child-process test verifies quiet stdout shutdown; traversal counters exclude emission errors.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.

tasks.title: Select the same project options and directory as the build
tasks.problem: Default project options can select a different cached source tree from the one used by the build.
tasks.proposal: Forward repeatable -o KEY VALUE and -C DIR to Project.
acceptance: Both conditional source variants are selected correctly by the real CLI fixture.
Repeated option keys use the last value.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.

tasks.title: Treat CAS origin enrichment as optional metadata
tasks.problem: Invalid UTF-8 or unavailable .gitreview metadata can abort otherwise valid searches.
tasks.proposal: Read bytes, decode with replacement and cache enrichment failure as unavailable metadata.
acceptance: Invalid UTF-8 metadata does not affect exit status or file matches.
Unavailable metadata is tested without suppressing actual file traversal failures.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.

tasks.title: Distinguish unresolved refs from missing caches
tasks.problem: Unresolved cache keys cause a leaked NoneType error and misleading fetch advice.
tasks.proposal: Check source resolution before querying the cache and print track/configure-ref guidance.
acceptance: Real unresolved remote source returns 2 with actionable advice and no TypeError.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.

tasks.title: Complete every owned mount teardown despite individual failures
tasks.problem: Unmount/removal failures can skip later mounts, child reaping or stream cleanup.
tasks.proposal: Isolate each teardown, reap each owned child and guarantee stream cleanup.
acceptance: Failure on the first mount does not skip later mounts.
Failed unmount still reaps the child; live retained mounts are reported.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.

tasks.title: Stream normal output without retaining every match
tasks.problem: The dedup set grows with full match output and search_errors stays zero on rg failures.
tasks.proposal: Enable compact dedup keys only for junction stripping; count failed searches per tree.
acceptance: Normal searches retain no dedup set.
Stripped-name duplicate file/line records still collapse.
An invalid regex returns 2 and increments search_errors in real FUSE CI.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.

tasks.title: Document per-mode runtime prerequisites
tasks.problem: Bubblewrap and the CAS daemon are needed even for filename searches.
tasks.proposal: List bwrap/buildbox-casd and the additional FUSE/rg/device/unmount requirements.
acceptance: README and tool guide identify required binaries and device access.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.

tasks.title: Require real FUSE integration in the compatibility matrix
tasks.problem: CAS-only CI cannot detect content-root, process and mount lifecycle regressions.
tasks.proposal: Install FUSE prerequisites and require real FUSE checks on minimum and latest supported BuildStream.
acceptance: CI fails when FUSE prerequisites are unavailable instead of silently skipping.
Minimum and latest 2.x validate slash filters, error counters and closed-pipe cleanup.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.

tasks.title: Establish a machine-readable task registry
tasks.problem: Future tools and agent iterations need durable tasks with acceptance criteria and evidence.
tasks.proposal: Keep a canonical JSON registry, generated Markdown view and stdlib validator in CI.
acceptance: Duplicate IDs, invalid fields, missing dependencies and dependency cycles are rejected.
CI rejects a stale Markdown index.
Agent instructions define status transitions and evidence requirements.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.

tasks.title: Measure startup, traversal, search and memory costs
tasks.problem: Existing aggregate timings do not identify dominant costs; proposed speedups are hypotheses. Reviewer-reported baseline (not reproduced here): 300 unique three-file trees, two runs/commit, 900 matches; mounting 15.5 s, search 0.095 s (one rg) versus 1.55 s (per-tree rg), wall 18.5 versus 20.0 s.
tasks.proposal: Create offline repeatable fixtures and a benchmark command separating fresh index, warm index, narrow glob, broad content and many identical source trees. Record versions, file/tree counts, peak RSS, mount count and process launches. Distinguish a fresh tool index from cold OS/BuildStream caches.
acceptance: Fixtures include many small files, few large files, many unique trees and duplicate trees.
Reports separate startup/load, traversal/index, mounts, rg search and output fan-out.
Benchmark writes only temporary caches and records repeat distributions rather than a single best time.
Establish baselines before adopting concurrency, SQLite or direct content blob search.
Reproduce the reported 300-tree fixture with exact runtime versions and compare serial versus small bounded pools before choosing concurrency.
Separate readiness-poll waiting from actual FUSE startup; ensure_mount currently polls every 50 ms, close to the reported 52 ms per tree.

tasks.title: Isolate the supported BuildStream compatibility boundary
tasks.problem: A large CLI module mixes private API access, binary discovery, matching, origins and process cleanup; broad introspection hides unsupported shapes.
tasks.proposal: First extract a narrow BuildStream adapter and typed element/tree records, then backend/output boundaries only where tests justify them. Keep the CLI stable and helpers tool-local until another tool needs them.
acceptance: Private API calls are concentrated behind the adapter.
Minimum/latest compatibility tests and CLI/output contracts remain unchanged.
Unexpected API failures produce a clear unsupported-version/shape diagnostic rather than a silent fallback.

tasks.title: Mount and search one tree at a time
tasks.problem: All source trees are mounted before searching, although rg now runs sequentially per tree. Peak mounts and resident daemon/process costs grow with unique trees.
tasks.proposal: Prioritize mount lifetimes after BSG-010 reproduces the reviewer baseline. Start with mount/search/cleanup scoped to one tree; compare a configurable small bounded pool, preserving resource ownership and output semantics. Reviewer measurements suggest serial mount startup (~52 ms/tree) dominates rg startup (~5 ms/tree), but pool speedups remain unmeasured. The reported mount stage includes a 50 ms readiness-poll interval in ensure_mount; measure that overhead and compare an adaptive shorter initial poll before attributing the whole stage to actual mount startup or adding a pool.
acceptance: Peak active owned mounts is one in serial mode.
All element mappings, origins, partial-error statuses and interruption cleanup are preserved.
Measure many-tree latency/RSS and identify any regressions against BSG-010.
For any pool, active owned mounts/processes never exceed the configured bound and cancellation/error cleanup covers every worker.

tasks.title: Reduce cold filename traversal and warm-index filtering work
tasks.problem: Filename traversal stats every file and traverses all subdirectories; warm JSONL indexes still require a full scan.
tasks.proposal: Profile stat/metadata work and compile reusable filter predicates. Evaluate safe directory pruning for narrow include prefixes; consider an alternate index only when scan cost is material. Never publish a query-filtered index as a complete tree index.
acceptance: Broad and narrow patterns preserve the same match set as the current implementation.
Complete cached indexes remain valid across different later queries.
Report measured wall-time/RSS tradeoffs on fresh and warm indexes before changing format.

tasks.title: Bound output buffering by bytes
tasks.problem: LineBuffer limits record count, so a small number of very long lines can still consume substantial memory.
tasks.proposal: Use a byte-aware buffer threshold and preserve streaming/backpressure behavior; document what rg itself buffers for long lines.
acceptance: Short/long-line workloads preserve JSON and text output.
Buffered memory has a documented bound except a single already-materialized match.
Closed-pipe and interruption tests still pass.

tasks.title: Provide actionable environment diagnostics
tasks.problem: Users currently discover missing binaries, FUSE permissions or cache layout problems one failure at a time.
tasks.proposal: Design --doctor or equivalent diagnostics for installed versions, project options, selected backend, cache directory, binaries and device access. Stay offline and avoid mutating project refs.
acceptance: Checks identify failure and next action without exposing credentials or private source origins by default.
Diagnostics distinguish CLI installation, cache absence, unresolved refs and FUSE access.
A machine-readable diagnostic format supports scripting.

tasks.title: Make filename glob limitations explicit and tested
tasks.problem: Filename matching implements a smaller glob dialect than rg; brace and negative include syntax can silently mean something different.
tasks.proposal: Define a shared documented subset and reject unsupported filename patterns clearly; decide whether full parity is worth an added library after differential tests.
acceptance: A table covers basename, slash, **, classes, dotfiles, case rules, include unions and exclusion precedence.
Unsupported brace/negative patterns never silently produce plausible wrong results.
CAS and FUSE filename modes agree for the supported subset.

tasks.title: Add result limits and predictable pipeline modes
tasks.problem: Users pipe to head for the first useful result, but loading/mounting and scanning may continue until pipe backpressure is observed.
tasks.proposal: Design global --max-results and quiet mode, with an explicit definition of emitted versus unique results and partial-cache behavior; evaluate line-buffered output for interactive use.
acceptance: Limits stop further scanning/mounting and reap active processes.
No partial path index is published after early termination.
Exit status, per-element fan-out and broken-pipe behavior are documented.

tasks.title: Inspect and prune path-index cache safely
tasks.problem: Versioned indexes accumulate and corrupt entries currently require manual rebuild flags; cache scope is opaque.
tasks.proposal: Add offline cache size/entry inspection and explicit prune/rebuild actions. Consider corruption fallback only with a visible diagnostic and no silently lost matches.
acceptance: Inspection shows version, digest, entry count and disk footprint.
Pruning does not remove in-use temporary indexes or unrelated caches.
Concurrent writers and corrupt/truncated indexes have regression coverage.

tasks.title: Publish concise recipes and output contracts
tasks.problem: Many flags make common grep/find tasks hard to discover, and text output is ambiguous for unusual filenames.
tasks.proposal: Document copy-paste recipes for project variants, C/C++ searches, filename search, rg-like statuses, JSON piping and origin inspection; publish a versioned JSON Lines contract.
acceptance: Recipes are exercised against a local fixture.
Examples distinguish BuildStream builders/max-jobs from search behavior without adding unrelated knobs.
JSON field/nullability and filename/encoding guarantees are explicit.

tasks.title: Make the task registry independent of locale encoding
tasks.problem: Registry index Unicode fails under an ASCII locale.
tasks.proposal: Use explicit UTF-8 reads/writes and test check/render with UTF-8 mode and locale coercion disabled.
acceptance: check/render/check succeeds with LC_ALL=C, PYTHONUTF8=0 and PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.

tasks.title: Prune .git directories during FUSE filename enumeration
tasks.problem: FUSE find enumerates .git subtrees only to reject their files afterwards.
tasks.proposal: Pass the same .git exclusion to rg --files as content search, retaining the shared post-filter.
acceptance: Filename and content results exclude root/nested .git files while slash filters still work.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.
